mechanism_narrative: Sustained growth in real GDP signals a strong economic expansion that boosts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward SPX returns are negative in > 40% of months following positive GDP growth, or GDP growth explains < 10% of SPX return variance over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate signals a rapidly weakening economy that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward SPX returns are positive in > 60% of months following a 0.5pp UNRATE spike, or UNRATE explains < 5% of SPX return variance over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in industrial production signals a supply shock that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward SPX returns are positive in > 40% of 3-month windows following a 2% INDPRO drop, or INDPRO explains < 10% of SPX return variance over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the federal funds rate signals a tightening monetary cycle that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward SPX returns are positive in > 60% of months following a 0.5pp FEDFUNDS hike, or FEDFUNDS explains < 5% of SPX return variance over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in housing starts signals a weakening consumer sector that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward SPX returns are positive in > 40% of 3-month windows following a 10% HOUST drop, or HOUST explains < 10% of SPX return variance over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in payroll employment signals a tightening labor market that will boost wage growth and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward SPX returns are negative in > 40% of months following a 300k PAYEMS spike, or PAYEMS explains < 5% of SPX return variance over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the consumer price index signals rising inflation expectations that will drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as investors demand higher nominal returns.
failure_condition: 60-day forward SPX returns are negative in > 40% of 3-month windows following a sustained CPI increase, or CPI explains < 10% of SPX return variance over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in real retail sales signals a surge in consumer spending that will boost corporate revenues and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward SPX returns are negative in > 40% of months following a 2% RSAFS spike, or RSAFS explains < 5% of SPX return variance over any 3-year window.
